name: KEBIMO SA
note: Senegalese building and public-works (BTP) group based in Dakar; a partner of ASC Ville de Dakar since at least 2024 (FCFA 40m), renewed 25 Nov 2025 with FCFA 20m for WBLA and BAL 2025-26 (Netcomsn), plus FCFA 10m for 2026 and FCFA 10m for the BAL campaign (Le Journal de Dakar, 13 Apr 2026). Its owner could not be documented from public sources — the company site names no owner, and its PDG/DG is named only in press (Netcomsn: 'Mamadou Kébé, PDG'; Le Journal de Dakar: 'Pape Mballo Kébé, DG' — a source disagreement over the first name, not the ownership) — so it stays unrated.
